description: Locate quoted text in a source with exact offsets, or classify it as normalized, elided, paraphrased or absent — Finds each quote an agent attributes to a source text and returns where it sits: exact offsets in UTF-16, code points, UTF-8 bytes and graphemes, so the span slices back to the matched text. Tries an exact match, then a match tolerant of whitespace, curly vs straight quotes, dash types, ellipses, invisible characters and Unicode forms (NFC/NFD, ligatures), naming which normalizations were needed,

exactOnly.description: Count only byte-identical matches as pass; normalized matches become fail. Default false.

ignoreCase.description: Also tolerate case differences (reported as a normalization). Default false.

minLength.description: Quotes shorter than this many characters (after trimming quote marks) are too-short and give unknown. Default 8.

quotes.description: Up to 50 quotes, 40000 characters in total.

source.description: Text the quotes are claimed to come from.

tolerate.description: Normalizations that still count as a match. Default: all six.

name: citation-span
